purpose: Work order #5537 (GEKTA-01, UX-12, UX-28): repair the existing public Gekta widget — lossless cold first open through one open operation, draft-only prompts, IME-safe composer with one POST per question, honest stream outcomes without automatic re-requests, generation-bound late responses, close/reopen and new-dialog safety, reader-controlled scroll, focus/modality and live-region feedback.
requiredBehavior: one open operation for every public Gekta entry point; a cold first click before the assistant chunk mounts is kept and delivered once
assistant chunk load failure shows explicit recovery instead of replacing the page with the global error screen
prompt and suggestion cards fill the editable composer and never submit; an existing draft is never replaced silently
Enter submits, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, IME composition Enter never submits; one user message and one POST per submit
EOF without done, network loss, timeout, malformed frames, 429, 5xx and offline are shown as interrupted or failed, never as complete, and never re-requested automatically
late responses of an older request or conversation never change the current one
close keeps draft and history; New dialog requires confirmation when a draft or conversation would be lost
auto-scroll only while the reader is at the end; otherwise offer a jump to new messages
modal dialog makes the background inert, returns focus to the opener and announces send/complete/interrupted/error once
forbiddenCapabilities: second chat store, controller, context or state machine
apps/api, prisma, migrations, auth, RBAC, RLS, tenant or role authority
bank, money, finality or FGIS behaviour
private tenant, deal or document identifiers in the public assistant
conversation content in URL or localStorage
CI, Lighthouse, security or acceptance threshold changes
production deployment or production chat POST
